post.description: Create or update a template. If `id` is provided, it will update the template.

Find all automation flows in the org that contain a `send-email` or `reply-email`
action referencing `old_template_id` and rewrite those actions to point at the
new template id (`{id}` path param). Intended to be called after a duplicated
template has been refined, so automations follow over to the new template.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: New template id (the duplicate that automations should be migrated onto)

old_template_id.description: Source template id that automations are being migrated away from

get.description:
List the automation flows, workflows and customer portals that currently
reference this template, without modifying anything. Powers the template
settings "used by" view and the pre-migrate preview, and uses the same
discovery as `migrateAutomationsForTemplate` so the preview matches what a
migrate would touch.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Template id to find references for

post.description: Get template detail and replace all variables (template variables and document generation)

must_include_unsubscribe_link.description: If true then include unsubscribe link in the email body

skip_document_generation.description: If true then skip document generation. This is useful when you want to replace html variables only. Speeds up the process.

post.description:
This endpoint allows to initiate an asynchronous process in replacing the template details & generating the documents.
On initial request, a jobId and STARTED status are returned. Subsequent requests can use this jobId to poll for the resolved template.
If still processing, it returns the jobId and IN-PROGRESS status. Upon completion or failure, it returns the final template or a failure status with reason.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Job ID for tracking the status of document generation action

must_include_unsubscribe_link.description: If true then include unsubscribe link in the email body

skip_document_generation.description: If true then skip document generation. This is useful when you want to replace html variables only. Speeds up the process.

post.description: Send emails to multiple recipients using a template

job_id.description: Job ID for tracking the status of a bulk message request

action.description:
Trigger an APPROVE OR CANCEL action for the bulk message request.

* APPROVE: Alias for APPROVE_WITH_CONSENT
* APPROVE_WITH_CONSENT: Approve the bulk message request and send emails to queued recipients with consent
* APPROVE_ALL: Approve the bulk message request and send emails to all queued recipients, including those without consent
* CANCEL: Cancel the bulk message request

post.description: Revert to the original system generated email template

Converts a legacy HTML email template into the email-builder block format.
Stores the new `json_template` (stringified block graph), re-renders `body`
from the resulting blocks, and stashes the original HTML at `backup.body`.
Returns 409 if the template is already converted unless `force=true`.

dryRun.description: When true, return the converted output without saving.

force.description: When true, overwrite an existing json_template.

as_copy.description: When true, leave the source template untouched and save the converted result as a NEW template (linked via original_template_id). The response is the new entity.

name.description: Optional name for the as_copy result. The UI sends a localized copy name (e.g. "Copy of <name> (Visual)") so the new template is named like the list-view "Duplicate" action. Ignored unless as_copy is true.

409.description: Template already converted; pass force=true to overwrite

EpilotAuth.description: Authorization header with epilot OAuth2 bearer token

EpilotOrg.description: Overrides the target organization to allow shared tenant access
EpilotOrg.name: x-epilot-org-id

_schema.description: URL-friendly identifier for the entity schema

_manifest.description: Manifest ID used to create/update the entity

name.description: Human-friendly name (flow_name / workflow name / portal name); may be absent.

flows.description: Automation flows whose send-email/reply-email actions reference this template

workflows.description: v2 workflows that own a referencing automation flow

portals.description: Customer portals whose email-template config references this template

portal_lookup_errored.description: True when the customer-portal lookup failed, so `portals` may be incomplete.

migrated_flow_count.description: Number of automation flows successfully rewritten to point at the new template

migrated_flow_ids.description: IDs of automation flows that were successfully migrated

migrated_workflow_count.description:
Number of v2 workflows whose `AUTOMATION` tasks point at a migrated automation flow.
Derived from `migrated_flow_ids` — a workflow is counted once even if multiple of
its tasks reference the same migrated flow.

migrated_workflow_ids.description: IDs of workflows (`wf-*`) that owned at least one migrated automation flow

migrated_portal_count.description:
Number of customer-portal email-template config rows whose references were rewritten
from the old template id to the new one (via customer-portal-api's
`migrateEmailTemplateReferences`).

migrated_portal_ids.description: Portal IDs whose email-template references were successfully rewritten

failed_flow_ids.description: IDs of automation flows whose `putFlow` update failed. Caller can retry or surface to the user.

failed_portal_ids.description: Portal IDs whose email-template reference rewrite failed in customer-portal-api.

portal_migration_errored.description:
True when the call to customer-portal-api threw before returning, so the portal
counts could not be computed. Flow/workflow results are still valid; the caller
should surface this and offer a retry of the portal migration.

_manifest.description: Manifest ID used to create/update the entity

brand_id.description: Brand ID. Equal 0 if available for All brands

template_type.description:
`partial` for blocks other templates reuse. A partial is never sent on its own, so it has
no subject. Unset for a regular template.

subject.description: Subject. Required, except for a partial (`template_type` partial).

body.example: Hi Ms Ny Huynh, </br> Thank you for your order. We will contact you shortly

bucket.description: S3 bucket where file is stored

inline.description:
If true then this attachment should not be offered for download (at least not in the main attachments list).\
The usecase is CID embedded image (aka inline image).

send_as_link.description: If true then this attachment is sent via link. The link is already inserted to email body by API caller. In this case, service doesn't process this attachment.

type.description: File type such as Document template, Document,... Use for replace variables on document template

copy_to_message.description: If true then this attachment is copied to the message and replaces corresponding one

DesignId.description:
Design Builder design linked to this template. When set, `{{design.*}}` placeholders
(e.g. `{{design.assets.logo.url}}`, `{{design.colors.primary}}`) are replaced with the design's
current values at templating time.

download_url.description: URL to download the attachment. This URL is not accessible until attachment is uploaded successfully.

upload_url.description: Post presigned URL to upload file

fields.description: Fields are provided by AWS to authenticate and validate the request. All fields should be included in form-data when performing upload request.

main_entity_id.description: The main entity ID. Use main entity in order to use the variable without schema slug prefix - or just pass directly to other object ID.

partials_only.description:
Only put the current content of the partials in, and leave every other variable as it is,
e.g. to preview a template without an entity.

portal_id.description:
The portal the send is for, e.g. the recipient's portal. Portal user variables
(`{{portalUser.*}}`) link to this portal. Without it the portal is derived from the template.

job_id.description: Job ID of the email template that is requested to replace and generate docs

doc_progress_count.description: Progress count of the documents that are needed to generate

result.description: Result of the email template that is replaced along with generated docs

SkipCreatingEntities.description: When true, it lets to send only the email by skip creating the thread & message entities.

CompleteThread.description: Whether the thread is marked as Done immediately after sending the message

BulkSendMessageRequest.description:
It takes a list of entity ids, treating each as a separate mainEntity to construct individual messages.
For e.g; if there some opportunityIds are provided, then each opportunityId is treated as a separate mainEntity to construct individual messages.

email_template_id.description: ID of email template to use for sending bulk emails

must_include_unsubscribe_link.description: If true then include unsubscribe link in the email body

recipient_ids.description: List of entity ids to use as recipients

BulkSendMessageRequestWithQuery.description:
It takes an entity query to derive recipient_ids, treating each as a separate mainEntity to construct individual messages.
For e.g; if the query is provided as `_schema:opportunity AND status:PENDING`,
  then all the opportunity Ids with status PENDING are treated as separate mainEntity to construct individual messages.

email_template_id.description: ID of email template to use for sending bulk emails

must_include_unsubscribe_link.description: If true then include unsubscribe link in the email body

recipient_query.description: Entity search query to select recipients

CustomVariables.description: Custom variables to be replaced in the email template

job_id.description: Job ID for tracking the status of bulk message action

status.description:
Status of the bulk message action
* PROCESSING: Bulk message action is processing the request
* QUEUEING: Bulk message action is generating emails to send in a queue
* SENDING: Bulk message action is sending emails from the queue
* SUCCESS: Bulk message action is completed successfully
* FAILED: Bulk message action is failed
* CANCELLED: Bulk message action was cancelled

total_queued.description: Total number of emails generated and queued for sending

queued.description: List of entity ids that are queued for sending

sent.description: List of entity ids and message ids that were sent successfully

failed.description: List of entity ids that were skipped or failed

CreatedBy.description: User ID who created the bulk message action

CreatedAt.description: Time when the bulk message action was created

UpdatedAt.description: Time when the bulk message action was last updated

ApprovedAt.description: Time when the bulk message action was last approved

ApproveAction.description:
Type of approval action for the bulk message request.
* APPROVE_WITH_CONSENT: Approve the bulk message request and send emails to queued recipients with consent
* APPROVE_ALL: Approve the bulk message request and send emails to all queued recipients, including those without consent

TaskToken.description: Task token to approve or cancel the bulk message action

JourneyContextUsagesRequest.description:
Shared request shape across journey-api's eight context-usage
adapters. `journey_id` is required for parity with the other seven,
but this adapter does not use it: email templates reference context
parameters by name and carry no journey id at all, so it cannot
narrow the search here.

journey_id.description: Journey the usage check originated from. Validated, not used by this adapter.

param_keys.description: Context parameter keys to search for, e.g. `contact_id`.

param_ids.description: Accepted and ignored. This adapter resolves context parameters by name only.

status.description: `partial` when a page cap, row cap, or soft deadline truncated the scan before every template was read.

scanned.description: Number of email templates read during the scan.

field.description: Email template field the match was found in.

at.description: Path the match was found at. Debugging and tests only.
